<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 262.09938) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈261.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1) suggests ~18 carbons. A formula C₁₈H₁₃O₂ gives a calculated monoisotopic mass of 261.0916 Da, matching the observed mass within <1 mDa, and its isotopic distribution fits the spectrum. Therefore the molecular formula is C18H13O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
